instructions:
1. Lie on your left side with legs stacked and body in a straight line. Rest your head on your left arm.
2. Extend your right arm overhead, reaching past your ear.
3. Reach long through the fingertips and let your top ribs lengthen until you feel a stretch down the side of your back.
4. Hold 15 to 30 seconds, breathing steadily.
5. Return to the start and switch sides.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep the reaching arm long to lengthen the lat and side ribs.
2. Tuck the pelvis slightly so the lower back does not arch.
3. Ease into the stretch, never force the end range.
4. Use a padded, non-slip surface.

instructions:
1. Lie on your right side with legs extended and stacked. Rest your head on your right arm and place your left hand on your hip.
2. Lift your left leg straight up, keeping it in line with your body.
3. Pause at the top and squeeze the outer hip.
4. Lower the leg slowly under control.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Lift with the hip, not momentum.
2. Keep the leg straight and in line with the torso.
3. Stop the lift before the hips roll back.
4. Exhale as you lift, inhale as you lower.

instructions:
1. Lie on your right side with legs stacked. Prop up on your right elbow, elbow under your shoulder.
2. Brace your core and lift your hips off the floor into a straight line from head to feet.
3. Hold the position, keeping the body straight and tight.
4. Lower your hips under control.
5. Switch sides.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep the elbow directly under the shoulder.
2. Hold a straight line, no sagging hips.
3. Keep the head in line with the spine.
4. Breathe steadily throughout the hold.

instructions:
1. Set up in a side plank on your right side, elbow under your shoulder, left hand on your hip.
2. Brace your core and lift your hips into a straight line.
3. Lower your hips toward the floor without touching it.
4. Drive the hips back up, squeezing the obliques at the top.
5. Switch sides.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Move slowly with control, no swinging.
2. Keep the elbow under the shoulder for support.
3. Squeeze the top obliques hard at the top of each rep.
4. Exhale as you lift the hips, inhale as you lower.
